map.CG = Σ(Wi × Armi) / ΣWi；校核 cgFwd ≤ CG ≤: CG = the weight-arm products summed / the weights summed; check cgFwd ≤ CG ≤ cgAft
map.总力矩为各装载项重量乘以其力臂之和，除以总重得重心位置；重心须落在前限 cgFw: The total moment is the sum of the weight of each item times its arm; dividing by the total weight gives the CG position, which must fall between the forward limit cgFwd and the aft limit cgAft, or the load cannot be released.
map.重心超出前限会导致抬头困难、失速速度增大；超出后限会导致纵向不稳定。本工具为教学: A CG forward of the limit makes rotation difficult and raises the stall speed; a CG aft of the limit causes longitudinal instability. This tool is a teaching estimate; actual flight must follow the type manual.

map.由使用空机重量与重心、各载荷（旅客/燃油/货）的重量与力臂，算全机重心位置。: From the basic empty weight and CG and the weight and arm of each load (passengers/fuel/cargo), compute the CG position of the whole aircraft.
map.校核重心是否落在允许包线（前限—后限）内，否则需重新配载。: Check whether the CG falls within the allowed envelope (forward limit to aft limit); otherwise the load must be rearranged.
map.评估燃油消耗过程中重心的前后漂移。: Assess the forward/aft CG drift as fuel is burned.
map.空机重 40000 kg、力臂 12.0 m（力矩 480000 kg·m）；加: Basic empty weight 40000 kg at arm 12.0 m (moment 480000 kg·m); add cargo 5000 kg at arm 8 m (40000 kg·m). Total weight 45000 kg and total moment 520000 kg·m, so CG = 520000/45000 ≈ 11.56 m, which must lie between the forward limit (11.0) and the aft limit (12.5) to be valid.
map.重心超限有什么危险？: What are the dangers of an out-of-limit CG?
map.重心过前限制俯仰操纵变重、起飞抬轮困难；过后限制纵向静不稳定、配平困难甚至失控。: A too-forward CG makes pitch control heavy and rotation on takeoff difficult; a too-aft CG causes longitudinal static instability, hard trim and even loss of control. The load sheet must therefore verify the CG envelope, and takeoff is not allowed if it is out of limits.
map.燃油消耗会让重心怎么变？: How does fuel burn change the CG?
map.燃油箱位置决定：中央油箱消耗使重心前移、翼油箱消耗使重心后移，飞行中重心在包线内: It depends on tank location: burning the center tank moves the CG forward while burning the wing tanks moves it aft; the CG drifts within the envelope in flight, and the design envelope already allows margin. This tool computes the static loading CG.
